videos.title: The missing guide to grids
videos.why: Sets up column, modular and combined grids, then from 16:13 places real content on them and, at 21:44, shows how to keep a gridded layout visually interesting; pause and copy one layout onto your own page.

videos.title: Why You Should Use a Grid for Designing Layouts
videos.why: The short case for grids from the reader's side, since aligned layouts are faster to scan and use; a far better argument to have in your head than 'it looks tidy'.

podcasts.why: Two product designers on when grid systems break down, including what to do when the grid does not divide neatly into real screen widths.
Anthony Hobday and Katie Langerman, both working interface designers, talk through layout decisions in product UI, including how to align main content next to a sidebar.

reads.title: Using Grids in Interface Designs
reads.why: Defines columns, gutters and margins and the three common grid types (column, modular, hierarchical); the vocabulary matches the grid anatomy figure.

reads.title: Grids & spacing
reads.why: How Google's system changes column count as the screen grows and uses 'rulers' to keep titles and content aligned; compare it with what happens when you widen the lab-grid layout.

reads.title: Grid
reads.why: How a design grid becomes real CSS Grid code, with tracks, gaps and named areas; skim the diagrams so you can describe a layout precisely to an AI tool.
